name: TherapyNotes vs Freed
title: TherapyNotes vs Freed: EHR vs AI Scribe Comparison
description: Compare TherapyNotes (mental health EHR) and Freed (AI scribe). Understand how these tools serve different purposes and can work together.

summary.bottom_line: TherapyNotes and Freed are complementary tools, not competitors. TherapyNotes is a mental health EHR for practice management (scheduling, billing, documentation storage, client portal). Freed is an AI scribe that generates clinical notes from session recordings. TherapyNotes manages your practice; Freed speeds up note writing. Many therapists use an EHR plus an AI scribe together.

sections.heading: TherapyNotes vs Freed: Overview
sections.content: TherapyNotes and Freed address different needs in a therapist's workflow. TherapyNotes is a comprehensive mental health EHR: scheduling, client intake portal, insurance billing, telehealth, documentation storage, and 24/7 support. Freed is an AI scribe that listens to therapy sessions and drafts progress notes. TherapyNotes stores and manages your notes; Freed helps write them faster. The comparison is about understanding their distinct roles, not choosing between them.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: TherapyNotes costs $69/month per clinician with unlimited notes, electronic claims, and telehealth included. Freed costs $39-119/month for AI documentation. Using both would cost $108-188/month, providing complete practice management plus AI-assisted note writing. TherapyNotes is competitively priced for EHRs; Freed is competitively priced for AI scribes. The combined cost may be justified by documentation time savings.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: TherapyNotes provides: appointment scheduling, client portal (TherapyPortal), electronic insurance claims, telehealth, note templates for mental health, treatment plans, 24/7 customer support, and secure document storage. Freed provides: ambient listening, AI-generated SOAP notes, therapy progress notes, psychiatry notes, ICD-10 coding suggestions (Premier), and note export. TherapyNotes manages your entire practice; Freed accelerates one specific task (writing notes).

recommendations.when: You need a complete mental health EHR with excellent support, and you're comfortable writing notes manually using TherapyNotes' templates
You want complete practice management AND want to reduce documentation time with AI—use Freed to draft notes, then copy into TherapyNotes
Never—Freed cannot replace an EHR. You need TherapyNotes or another EHR for scheduling, billing, and client management regardless of using Freed

faqs.q: Does Freed integrate directly with TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Freed does not currently list TherapyNotes as a native push integration. You would use Freed to generate notes, then copy them into TherapyNotes. Freed Premier has native push for SimplePractice and Athenahealth, but TherapyNotes integration would require copy-paste.

No. Freed only generates clinical notes—it cannot schedule appointments, manage clients, process insurance claims, or provide a client portal. You need an EHR like TherapyNotes for practice management.

faqs.q: Is TherapyNotes good for AI documentation?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes does not have built-in AI ambient listening or AI note generation like Freed. TherapyNotes focuses on practice management with excellent support. For AI documentation, you would add a tool like Freed to your workflow.

They save time on different tasks. TherapyNotes streamlines scheduling, billing, and practice operations. Freed specifically reduces documentation time by auto-generating notes. If note-writing is your bottleneck, Freed addresses that directly.
